transcript: Speaker A: Regarding means about. It shows the topic. We talk about something. Concerning means about. It is a little more serious. We use it for important topics. Among means about in a group. More than two people. Inside many. Beyond means farther than. Something is more or outside. Considering means thinking about. It shows a reason. We look at a situation. Following means after. It shows what comes next. Something happens later. Pending means waiting. It is not finished yet. We wait for a result. Versus means against. It shows comparison. Two things are different. Throughout means everywhere. In all parts. From start to end.
